hooks.name: Review dependencies on save
hooks.description: Validates pinned versions, GCP-only SDKs, and current Google Gen AI SDKs in manifests.

action.prompt: A dependency manifest was just saved. Check that: versions are pinned exactly; no AWS/Azure SDKs; no non-Google model SDKs (openai, anthropic); Google AI uses google-genai / @google/genai (not google-generativeai or @google/generative-ai) and google-adk / @google/adk; package names are not typosquats. Report findings briefly and suggest fixes.
